declarations.reason: The run's yard dressing, pickups and barricades are regenerated every run from the zone catalog and run seed, and they move or vanish with the compactor, so they stay runtime-owned. The static silhouette is authored: editor.scene.json places the water-tower crowns, one landmark cluster per yard, crane-leg pylons at each yard seam and the alternating shoulder sentries (scripts/author-corridor.ts), all outside the fenced driving line. The yard tracks other than Row Six are authored as `course` markers in editor.scene.json (road, shortcuts and their hazard, barricade, drop, zone and landmark slots; the Reroute is generated from its dials and the day's seed). Their edges, lamps, scatter, landmark props and hazard set-pieces stay runtime-owned: src/game/world/setup.ts places them from each course and its track theme, so moving a piece of a course moves its scenery with it.
